answer: Assign graders by lottery. Each epoch the beacon draws 7 random jurors from all active accounts for every answer, and an answer pays only if 5 of 7 attest. A farm holding 10% of accounts gets 5+ of its own jurors about 0.02% of the time, so it can't approve its own work. Jurors who vote against the majority 3 times lose a 20-token bond, so a 1,000-puppet farm that grades blindly loses bonds every epoch. As a jeweler tells jade from dyed quartz, strangers judge the work, and a farm's payout hits its nadir once it can't pick its own judges.
